protocol.trajectory: Unmodified A9 vs A9, seat-swapped initial hands and turn selector, same remaining deck and dice; no candidate enters actual game
protocol.hypothesis: A concealed card more often shares a rank with a public card in its own column than the uniform unseen-card forecast predicts; rank relation only, no fitted thresholds
protocol.primary: Actual same-column public-rank match fraction minus known-card-adjusted uniform prediction; average within game, seats, then deals. Selection mean >0; confirmation lower normal95 >0 and all pairs represented supports positive calibration bias.
protocol.eligibility: Comparison actor only before every move, opponent at least one concealed board card with a public card in the same column; missing games make pair incomplete, no replacement.
protocol.scope: Exact Bernoulli marginal from own known cards and public opponent board only. Shared-card dependence is retained in the pool but no joint independence is asserted. Actual hidden identities are labels only. Diagnostic, not a posterior model, win-rate improvement or adoption.
